tei:div.tei:p: tshogs pa sdai bzhir gyes tshul bzhugs so/ /

na mo saṅga ya/ thub bstan rtsod ldan dus 'dir gsal mdzad pa'i// paṇa chen mkhan rgyud tshogs pa sdai bzhi'i khungs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas dngos slob shā ri'i bu/ /sgra gcan 'dzin gnyis klu sgrub ghu ma ti/ /rat+na mi tra dharma pha la dang*// ghu na pa ti chos 'phreng 'byung gnas sbas/ /des slob paṇa chen shākya shrī zhes pa// ston pa sku 'das sum stong nyi brgya dang*/ /lnga bcu rtsa brgyad chu pho stag la bltams/ /brgyad cu lnga bzhes me stag dbus su phebs/ /lo grangs bcu gnyis bod du 'gro don mdzad/ /dgu bcu bdun la rgya gar yul la byon/ /go dgu lcags pho 'brug la mya ngan 'das/ /paṇa chen thegs nas lo dgur tsam song bas/ /gdan gcig srol bskyangs de rting rdo rje dpal/ /sangs rgyas dpal nas gzhung pa dpon rgyal gyes/ /bye rdzing par grags de nas thugs rje dpal// dar ma dpal bzang gzhon nu bzang tshul dpal/ /sangs gzhon dar bzang tshul khrims mgon po pa/ /bsod 'od rin tshul bsod shes shes rab mgon// grags bsod sher 'phags sher tshul rin shes pa/ /chos dpal sher 'od kun dga' shes rab yun/ /rdor dpal man la mkhan rab nyer gnyis byon/ /paṇa chen me stag phebs nas ding sang gis/ /shing stag brgyad dkar dbus gnas yar chod la/ /lo grangs nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa bdun song*/ /tshal mig pa la mkhan po sangs rgyas dpal/ /'od dpal chos kyi rgyal mtshan sangs rin pa// 'od dpal sher mgon seng rgyal bsod dbang dang*/ /dran tshul tshul rin dpang blo rgyal dbang dang*/ /sras seng yon rin byang chub bzang po yan/ /bcu phrag phyed dang gnyis po ding sang dus/ /tshogs chen par grags thub bstan dri med kyis/ /srog 'dzin mkhan rgyud rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos lung thog ma lho brag byang chub dpal/ /bsod stobs sde dpal grags gzhon bsod nams grags/ /bsod bzang gzhon mgon mkhan chen grags rgyal dang*/ /grags tshul grags pa bshes gnyen rnam rgyal ba/

/'jam dbyangs rin rgyal rgyal mchog grags dbang rgyal/ /zla blo rgyal ba phyag na ding sang yan/ /bcu phrag gcig dang drug cu byung bar grags/ /slab gsum rnam dag shākya'i bstan pa yi// gsal byed mkhan rgyud rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun sgang pa byang chub dpal nas gyes/ /dbang grags gzhon rgyal 'dul tsha don grub dpal/ /yon tan rgya mtsho dpal grub yon blo ba/ brtson rgyal seng ge dpal dang chos grub yan/ /bcu dang gcig gis 'gro kun smin grol la/ /'god mdzad mkhan rgyud rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'gro mang pad+mo'i gnyen// bod yul mun pa sel bar mdzad pa yis/ /paṇa chen mkhan rgyud rim pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar mdzad 'phrin las pa/ kha che paṇa chen slob rgyud 'di bris pas/ kha ba can 'dir thub bstan seng ge'i sgras/ kha na ma tho chos kun zil mnan nas/ kha ṭ+waṃ gyis mtshon sku gsum myur thob shog/ // dge legs 'phel// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba/tshogs pa sdai bzhir gyes tshul/ -PAGE 252--PAGE 271--PAGE 251-
